message: No detected input validation: The code uses argparse for CLI parsing and assert_for_log for some internal state checks, but there is no systematic validation of incoming data structure, types, or value ranges for the data acquisition inputs.

No detected untrusted source handling: ELMO model files are fetched from a hardcoded S3 URL with no checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned revision; no integrity checks are present for any remote data source.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing pipeline loads and tokenizes data without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model states and pretrained weights (e.g., ELMo from an S3 URL, HuggingFace transformers) without any hash verification, signature checking, or pinned revision; it simply constructs paths and loads files directly.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No DP-SGD, Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or any differential privacy mechanism is imported or applied in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or invoked anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics as a tamper-protection mechanism in the visible code.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path parses CLI arguments and config files but performs no input shape, range, or schema validation on data passed to the model before inference.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible inference path checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or other sanity constraints before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the pipeline handles text tasks, there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection present in the visible code.
